findings.ac: Unit test for --rebuild-indices on a tmp tree
findings.text: No test asserts the core output format of rebuild_indices() for frontmatter files: `* [Title](/docs/nightly/nightly-2026-10-04.md) - description` lines, the `# <dirname>` heading, or that index.md itself is excluded. test_rebuild_is_idempotent only compares run 1 to run 2 (and the count 4), and the only exact-line assert is the no-frontmatter stem fallback in test_file_without_frontmatter_falls_back_to_stem, so title/description extraction (_title_description) is unproven.

main() suppresses compare() output for a row closed on GitHub (`drift = [closed] if closed else compare(...)`), but test_reconcile.all_open_checks only checks that the closed line appears; it never asserts other-field drift is suppressed. The `[MIRROR-OK N open rows]` success line and the clean offline --all-open exit 0 are also untested.
